info.name: Shagung E-commerce - User API
info.description:
User-facing API endpoints for Shagung E-commerce Platform.

Base URL: {{baseUrl}}

## Authentication
Most endpoints require Bearer token in Authorization header.
Get token from login response.

## Variables
- baseUrl: http://localhost:5000
- token: User JWT token
